title: Crow caws, gull calls and the harbour's water
caption: A crow caws when scared off a perch, gulls cry near you, and the harbour has water lapping at the quay. These are sounds, so the pictures are their spectrograms; walk to the forecourt or the harbour to hear them.

sections.title: Chosen takes (Stable Audio 3, best of four each, scored with CLAP)
sections.caption: Crow: two or three harsh caws. Gull: a long cry, then a short one. Harbour: calm lapping, the steadiest of four, looped without a seam.
